evidence.note: Fuel-filler-side door is visibly shut before manipulation.
Hand pulls the handle and the door begins opening.
Door is fully open, exposing the cabin.
Door remains open near the end of the episode.
Door is visibly shut again.

events.object_description: Fuel-filler-side car door, first open-close episode

evidence.note: Opposite-side car door is shut.
Hand operates the door handle.
Door has swung open.
Door remains fully open.
Hand pushes the door inward to close it.
Door is shut again.

events.object_description: Opposite-side car door, second distinct open-close episode

evidence.note: Front hood is closed.
Hand reaches the hood edge to lift it.
Hood is partway through its upward motion.
Hood is fully raised and the engine bay is exposed.
Hood remains raised.
Hood is being lowered toward the latch.
Hood is fully closed.
Rear hatch is closed.
Hand reaches under the rear edge to release and lift the hatch.
Hatch is moving upward.
Hatch is fully open and the cargo compartment is exposed.
Hatch remains open immediately before closing.
Hand lowers the hatch through an intermediate position.
Rear hatch is fully closed.

notes: Four distinct manipulation episodes are visible. The initial and intervening camera orbits are survey/repositioning movements and were not counted.
scene_description: A user circles a parked blue Toyota Supra, separately opening and closing both side doors, the front hood, and the rear cargo hatch.
